data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'fern' meaning 'forest, fern'. The name Vern is of Old English origin and is a masculine name. It is a strong and brave name, symbolizing strength and courage. The name Vern carries the meaning “Brave, strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vern usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
